$comment: Typography pairings. Each stack names a recommended web font first, then installed system faces that keep the same character, so pages look right with zero font downloads. 'webfont' is an optional Google Fonts URL for projects that want the exact faces. Scales are fluid between 360px and 1440px viewports.

pairings.name: Editorial Serif + Grotesque Sans
pairings.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

pairings.name: Precision Dev Sans + Mono
pairings.use: Developer tools, infra dashboards, docs, command palettes.
pairings.mono: "Geist Mono", "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

pairings.name: Financial Condensed
pairings.use: Trading, analytics, KPI walls, sports data. Condensed headings fit more numbers per row.
pairings.display: "Barlow Condensed", "Roboto Condensed", "Avenir Next Condensed", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif-condensed, sans-serif
pairings.body: "IBM Plex Sans", "Helvetica Neue", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif
pairings.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

pairings.name: Warm Humanist
pairings.use: Consumer apps, health, education, onboarding. Friendly but adult.
pairings.display: "Source Sans 3", "Seravek", "Gill Sans Nova", "Gill Sans", "Segoe UI", Calibri, sans-serif
pairings.mono: "Source Code Pro", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

pairings.name: Swiss Neo-Grotesk
pairings.use: Product marketing, agency sites, posters. Tight, rational, grid-first.

pairings.name: Classic Book Serif
pairings.use: Long reads, documentation prose, literary sites. Serif everywhere, generous leading.
pairings.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

pairings.name: Geometric Product
pairings.use: Startups, mobile apps, fintech consumer. Round geometry, clean numerals.

pairings.name: Technical Mono Display
pairings.use: Changelogs, terminal products, hardware, lab tools. Mono headings, sans body.
pairings.display: "JetBrains Mono", "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace
pairings.body: "IBM Plex Sans", "Helvetica Neue", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif
pairings.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

pairings.name: Luxury Didone + Geometric
pairings.use: Fashion, hospitality, luxury retail. High-contrast display, quiet geometric body.

pairings.name: Modern Slab + Sans
pairings.use: Learning products, recipe and outdoor brands, sturdy marketing.

pairings.name: Data-Dense Condensed Sans
pairings.use: Admin consoles, tables with 12+ columns, monitoring. Small, sharp, tabular.
pairings.display: "IBM Plex Sans Condensed", "Roboto Condensed", "Avenir Next Condensed", "Arial Narrow", sans-serif
pairings.body: "IBM Plex Sans", "Helvetica Neue", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif
pairings.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

pairings.name: Friendly Rounded
pairings.use: Kids, games, casual consumer, playful onboarding without going childish.
pairings.display: "Nunito", ui-rounded, "SF Pro Rounded", "Varela Round", "Segoe UI", sans-serif
pairings.body: "Nunito", ui-rounded, "SF Pro Rounded", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif
